note: Uncalibrated VLM preview; human scoring remains pending. Image delivery does not establish grading accuracy.

instruction.reason: The main clip lab flows work, but substantial specified contracts fail: idle interpolation magnitudes, walk looping-at-duration semantics, fade interpolation, and seek during fade. The required API, readouts, events, and reset are otherwise present in one coherent page.

interaction.reason: Single actions, playback, stepping, and reset work, but the required sequence and fade-boundary contracts fail, including non-advancing fade state after seek. Some failures are only disclosed by numeric state probes, although the UI presents clear feedback for the flows it does implement.

spatial.reason: The rig reads clearly in 3D with plausible scale and joints, and rotation/pose changes are visible with coherent lighting and shadows. Exact geometry and hierarchy could not be probed; the large mobile readout also obscures the upper rig.

stability.reason: Loading and reload are clean with no console errors and only local successful requests; repeated playback, reset, and viewport changes did not crash. The broken fade update under seek is a local nonblocking contract issue, and mobile presentation is obstructed.

visual.reason: Desktop composition, typography, color, and 3D form are coherent and legible. State changes improve understanding, but mobile overlays the rig and some secondary UI text is faint.
